scope: How a source passage frames an issue, not which historical account is true.

labels.problem_definition: Defines a condition, actor, event, or outcome as the relevant problem.
labels.causal_interpretation: Attributes a cause, responsibility, or mechanism to an event or condition.
labels.moral_evaluation: Expresses or reports praise, blame, legitimacy, injustice, duty, or another normative judgment.
labels.treatment_recommendation: Advocates, rejects, or evaluates a remedy, response, policy, or course of action.

rules: Do not force a frame when no framing function is explicitly supported.
Every frame candidate requires an exact cue quotation.
Topic labels such as military or humanitarian are not frames.
Model assignments remain candidates until human review.
